property_summary: General rule: when called by the admin, setOwner sets owner to the provided _owner argument (i.e., owner equals the function parameter); the bug breaks this by setting owner to tx.origin instead, so for some fuzzed admin caller and _owner value the resulting owner differs from the provided _owner.
change_summary: Assign owner to tx.origin instead of provided _owner, so owner becomes transaction origin after setOwner.
